parties: Hari Krishan Agarwal (acquirer) vs. Campus Activewear Limited (target)
headline: Hari Krishan Agarwal files substantial acquisition disclosure in Campus Activewear under SEBI Reg. 31(4)
sum: Hari Krishan Agarwal has filed a mandatory SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure signalling a material change in shareholding or control of Campus Activewear Limited. The filing indicates crossing of a threshold (likely 25% or entry into a binding agreement for control) and triggers the full takeover-disclosure regime.
implication: Disclosure triggers immediate halt on further acquisitions pending regulatory approval; partners must review concert-party arrangements, conditions precedent, and NCLT/CCI gating items under the Takeover Code.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Hari Krishan Agarwal's disclosure to NSE signals either a 25% threshold crossing or a binding agreement to acquire control of Campus Activewear Limited. The filing must be accompanied by supporting documents detailing consideration, conditions precedent, and approvals sought. The disclosure is now in the public domain and locks both parties into a regulated acquisition timeline.
